candidate_relations.reason: Episodic ataxia type 1 is a channelopathy not supported by this late-onset functional pattern.
Multiple system atrophy is a neurodegenerative synucleinopathy with progressive hard signs, which are absent.
Conversion disorder is the historical alias of functional neurological disorder.
Autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia is a genetic degenerative ataxia not fitting this course.
Cervicogenic dizziness is a musculoskeletal alternative, not FND.
Functional disorder is a parent label missing the neurological (FND) specification.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: functional disorder parent missing neurological specifier

candidate_relations.reason: Spinocerebellar ataxia is a degenerative cerebellar disease, not FND.
Cerebrovascular disease is contradicted by lack of new MRI lesions and normal hemodynamics.
BPPV causes brief positional vertigo, not days-to-weeks of continuous dizziness.
Vestibular neuritis is a monophasic peripheral vestibulopathy, not recurrent resolving attacks.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: vestibular neuritis vs recurrent FND attacks

candidate_relations.reason: Functional neurological disorder is identical to the reference diagnosis.
Cervical vertigo is the same unsupported cervicogenic alternative.
